result.explanation: Maintain each begun job’s phase and resources, plus current ownership and committed IDs. A begin is atomic: it succeeds only when the ID is unused and every requested resource is free. Prepare, commit, and abort enforce the stated phase transitions.
result.mapping: The state maps job IDs to phases and resource lists, held maps resources to owners, and done stores committed IDs. The output status reports the current event result; held and sorted done expose the resulting aggregate state.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the documented identifier, resource, event, and numeric constraints. Resource and job identifiers are strings, and event types are exactly begin, prepare, commit, or abort.
result.holds: function holds(input,out){if(!Array.isArray(out)||!input||!input.config)return false;let s=null;for(let i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){let r=solve({config:input.config,state:s,event:input.events[i]});s=r.state;let a=out[i],b=r.output;if(!a||a.status!==b.status||JSON.stringify(a.held)!==JSON.stringify(b.held)||JSON.stringify(a.done)!==JSON.stringify(b.done))return false}return out.length===input.events.length}
result.program: function solve(x){let c=x.config,e=x.event,s=x.state;if(!s)s={j:{},h:{},d:[]};else{s={j:Object.assign({},s.j),h:Object.assign({},s.h),d:s.d.slice()};for(let k in s.j)s.j[k]=Object.assign({},s.j[k],{r:s.j[k].r.slice()})}let status="invalid",id=e.id;if(e.type==="begin"){let ok=!s.j[id];if(ok)for(let i=0;i<e.resources.length;i++)if(s.h[e.resources[i]]!==undefined)ok=false;if(ok){s.j[id]={p:"active",r:e.resources.slice()};for(let i=0;i<e.resources.length;i++)s.h[e.resources[i]]=id;status="begun"}else status="blocked"}else if(s.j[id]){let j=s.j[id];if(e.type==="prepare"){if(j.p==="active"){j.p="prepared";status="prepared"}}else if(e.type==="commit"){if(j.p==="prepared"){j.p="committed";for(let i=0;i<j.r.length;i++)delete s.h[j.r[i]];s.d.push(id);s.d.sort();status="committed"}}else if(e.type==="abort"){if(j.p==="active"||j.p==="prepared"){j.p="aborted";for(let i=0;i<j.r.length;i++)delete s.h[j.r[i]];status="aborted"}}}let held={};for(let i=0;i<c.resources.length;i++){let k=c.resources[i];if(s.h[k]!==undefined)held[k]=s.h[k]}return{state:s,output:{status:status,held:held,done:s.d.slice()}}}
